Mesha.text: Today brings a sense of introspection as you navigate the complexities of your daily routine. Your focus is pulled toward internal matters as Shani moves through your twelfth house, which often signals a time to retreat and process lingering emotions. Because you are currently in the rising phase of Sade Sati, it is wise to prioritize rest and avoid unnecessary external pressures. Budha in your sixth house offers a sharp mind for managing details, helping you clear small obstacles that have been lingering. However, Kuja in your third house feels blocked, suggesting that your usual drive might meet some resistance today. Chandra in the sixth house is also blocked by Shani, urging you to be patient with your physical energy levels. Guru in your fourth house is adverse, so try to keep your home environment peaceful rather than seeking major changes. Shukra in your seventh house is adverse, reminding you to handle personal interactions with extra grace and softness. Rahu in the eleventh house is favourable, providing a subtle boost to your long-term aspirations. Ketu in the fifth house is adverse, so avoid over-analyzing your creative projects today. Trust that even in stillness, you are making progress.
Mesha.advice: Focus on completing small, practical tasks rather than initiating new, complex projects.
